metadata.title: my-agents
metadata.description: Frontend console for private chats and shared knowledge bases

brand.name: my-agents
brand.description: Frontend console for private conversations and shared knowledge bases

home.title: An AI workspace that answers from your documents.
home.description: Add documents, ask questions, and check the citations that show where each answer came from.
featureCards: Add PDFs, Markdown, text notes, Excel workbooks, or PowerPoint decks to a knowledge base.
Ask in the central chat and let the AI use the sources you choose.
Open citations beside answers to verify the supporting passages.
transcriptRows: You: What are the renewal risks in this contract?
AI: I found the relevant clauses and summarized them.
activityItems: Add documents to a knowledge base
home.citationText: Answers keep supporting passages close so you can verify them quickly.
home.sourceText: Organize uploaded files and notes into spaces that the AI can reference.

auth.heroDescription: Sign in to add sources, ask questions, and verify answers with citations.
features: Upload or write sources into a knowledge base.
Ask follow-up questions from the same workspace.
Review citations without leaving the answer.
auth.signupDescription: Create an account, verify your email, then start building your AI workspace.
auth.loginDescription: Log in and continue asking questions from your sources.
auth.nicknameHint: Shown to group owners/admins in member lists. This is not your login identity.
auth.signupSuccessDescription: We created {email}. Check your inbox for the verification link, then log in with this account.
auth.signupPendingApprovalDescription: We created {email}. After operator approval, a verification email will be sent.
auth.guestPageDescription: Request a guest code by email, then enter it below to start a limited demo.
auth.guestDescription: Enter an email to request a demo code. Guest sessions last 24 hours and have limited chats, prompts, and uploads.
auth.guestEmailHint: If approved, the operator will send a guest access code to this address.
auth.guestRequestReceivedDescription: We received the request for {email}. If approved, a guest code will be sent to that inbox.
auth.guestCodeDescription: Redeem the code from your email to start the limited demo session.
auth.guestCodeHint: Codes are one-time use and expire automatically.
auth.emailVerificationWorkingDescription: Please wait while we confirm your verification link.
auth.emailVerificationSuccessDescription: Your account is verified. You can now log in and open the service console.
auth.emailVerificationFailedDescription: The verification link may be expired or already used. Try signing up again or request a new verification email later.
auth.emailVerificationMissingDescription: Open the full verification link from your email, including the token query parameter.
auth.passwordResetRequestDescription: Enter your account email and we will send a reset link.
auth.passwordResetRequestHint: Use the address you signed up with.
auth.passwordResetRequestSentDescription: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
auth.passwordResetDescription: Enter a new password to complete the reset flow.
auth.passwordResetMissingDescription: Open the full password reset link from your email, including the token query parameter.
auth.passwordResetSuccessDescription: Your password has been updated. Log in with the new password.
auth.groupInvitationWorkingDescription: We are checking this invitation for the signed-in account.
auth.groupInvitationSuccessDescription: You can now open Groups and use shared knowledge according to your role. Your conversations and memory remain private.
auth.groupInvitationFailedDescription: Sign in with the invited email address, then open the invitation link again. Expired or cancelled invitations cannot be used.
auth.groupInvitationMissingDescription: Open the full invitation link from your email, including the token query parameter.
auth.groupInvitationRedirectingDescription: This invitation link proves the invited email. Continue by choosing a display name and password.
auth.groupInvitationSignupDescription: Your invitation link already proves the email address. Choose a display name and password; future sign-in uses the invited email and password, not the display name.
auth.groupInvitationLoginDescription: Sign in with the invited email address. After login, we will return to this invitation and add the account to the group.

service.sessionRestored: Ready to ask from your sources.
sessionEvidenceItems: Add sources, then ask in chat.
Group sharing is available when needed.

onboarding.guestPromptTitle: See how the guest demo works
onboarding.guestPromptBody: Take a short tour of limits, asking, source selection, and citations before you use the demo.
onboarding.newUserPromptBody: Learn where to add knowledge, ask questions, and verify answers.
onboarding.targetFallback: This item is not visible on the current screen, so this step is shown without a highlight.

steps.guestLimitsBody: Guest sessions are temporary and limited, so use them to try the core flow before creating a full account.
steps.guestAskBody: Type a focused question here. Accepted guest prompts count toward the demo limit.
steps.guestSourcesBody: Use this selector to decide whether the answer can reference all available sources or selected knowledge bases only.
steps.guestAddSourcesTitle: Add sources when you need evidence
steps.guestAddSourcesBody: Open Sources to upload a small number of documents for the demo. Upload limits are enforced automatically.
steps.guestEvidenceBody: When an answer uses knowledge, citations and work history appear here so you can verify what supported it.
steps.newKnowledgeSpaceTitle: Create or choose a knowledge base
steps.newKnowledgeSpaceBody: Use this one Sources page to give your files and notes a clear home before you ask questions from them.
steps.newSourceDestinationBody: Sources stay in the selected knowledge base. Group destinations use the same visible workflow when you have permission.
steps.newUploadSourceBody: Use this area for PDF, Markdown, plain-text, Excel (.xlsx), or PowerPoint (.pptx) files. You can also add text sources from the form on this page.
steps.newChatThreadBody: Start a new Ask thread when you are ready to question your knowledge. Threads keep questions and answers together.
steps.newSelectKnowledgeTitle: Pick the sources for the answer
steps.newSelectKnowledgeBody: Use the selector to ask from all available sources or only the spaces you choose.
steps.newAskQuestionBody: Write the question here. The answer appears in the transcript and can stream as the run progresses.
steps.newReviewEvidenceBody: When an answer uses your sources, citations and safe work history stay attached beside the answer for review.

chat.title: Ask
chat.description: Ask questions and keep cited sources beside each answer.
chat.noConversationsDescription: Create a question thread to begin.
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete "{title}"? This removes the conversation and all messages. This cannot be undone.
chat.deleteConversationActiveRunDisabled: Stop the active answer before deleting this conversation.
chat.selectOrCreateConversation: Select or create a question thread
chat.noActiveConversationDescription: Create a thread to unlock the composer.
chat.streamingComposerPlaceholder: Type a follow-up — it will send after this answer.
chat.queuedComposerPlaceholder: Edit or cancel the queued follow-up before adding another.
chat.sendNowHelper: Enter queues your follow-up. Send now stops the current answer first, then sends this message.
chat.sendNowWaitingForRun: Waiting for the active answer before it can be stopped.
chat.sendNowQueuedBlocked: Edit or cancel the queued message before sending a different message now.
chat.queuedHelper: Will send after the current answer finishes.
chat.queuedAfterFailureHelper: The current answer failed. Send this queued message manually, edit it, or cancel it.
chat.guestPromptLimitHelper: Guest demo limits are enforced automatically; queued and immediate messages still count when accepted.
chat.queuedAnnouncement: Message queued to send after the current answer.
chat.queueEditAnnouncement: Queued message moved back to the composer.
chat.queueAlreadyExistsAnnouncement: A queued message already exists. Edit or cancel it first.
chat.stoppingCurrentAnswerAnnouncement: Stopping the current answer before sending your message.
chat.currentAnswerStoppingAnnouncement: Stop request accepted. Waiting for the current answer to close.
chat.immediateFailedAnnouncement: Could not stop the current answer. Your message was restored to the composer.
chat.noRunsDescription: Send a message to create the first run.
chat.noEventsDescription: Latest run events will appear here.
chat.noCitationsDescription: Citations appear here when the answer uses added sources.
chat.messageEvidenceUnavailable: Sources and work history attach to the latest answer.
chat.guestNoticeDescription: This guest session lasts 24 hours and is limited to one chat, 5 prompts, and 3 document uploads. If you hit a limit, a safe error appears here.
chat.knowledgeSourceDescription: Choose which authorized personal or group knowledge bases Ask may reference. System project knowledge may also be added automatically when available.
chat.noKnowledgeBasesDescription: Create a knowledge base, add sources, then select it here.
chat.knowledgeSourceRequired: Select at least one knowledge base or switch back to All sources.
chat.replaySuccess: Regenerated. The conversation was refreshed with the replay result.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailable: Regenerated using currently available sources only. Some sources from the original answer are no longer available.
chat.replaySourcesUnavailableAnnouncement: Assistant message regenerated with unavailable original sources omitted.
chat.replayFailed: Could not regenerate this assistant message.
chat.replayFailedAnnouncement: Assistant message regeneration failed. Conversation state was refreshed.
chat.replayConflict: Only the latest assistant message can be regenerated right now.
chat.replayConflictAnnouncement: This assistant message cannot be regenerated because it is not the latest replayable answer.
chat.answerContextAllSources: All available sources could be used
chat.answerContextSelectedSources: Only selected knowledge bases were used
chat.answerContextNoAddedKnowledge: No added sources were needed for this answer
chat.activeRunStale: This answer appears interrupted. Checking run status…
chat.activeRunStaleHelper: This answer may have been interrupted. We are checking its status now; if it fails, you can retry or send your queued message.
chat.knowledgeSourceBoundaryCopy: This thread stays private. Selected personal, shared, and group knowledge bases are used only as sources for this answer.
chat.systemAmbientBoundaryCopy: System project knowledge is managed separately and may be included automatically; selecting fewer personal or group sources does not disable it.

common.emptyListDescription: Create one from the form above.

knowledge.title: Knowledge bases
knowledge.description: Create spaces for files and notes, add sources, then ask from Ask with citations.
knowledge.scopeHint: Personal knowledge bases stay private to your account. Group knowledge bases are shared libraries for selected groups after sharing is approved. System knowledge bases are public project knowledge managed only by privileged users.
knowledge.groupHint: Required for extra group knowledge bases. Only groups where you are owner/admin are listed.
knowledge.groupDisabledHint: Choose group scope to select an existing group.
knowledge.noGroupsDescription: Create a group or ask a group owner/admin before creating another group knowledge base.
knowledge.scopeBoundaryNote: New groups automatically get one default group knowledge base. Add sources to personal spaces first; sharing with a group requires owner/admin approval and does not share member conversations or private additions. System project spaces are available to authenticated Ask users, so never add secrets or private records.
knowledge.listPersonalSubtitle: Personal knowledge base · private to your account
knowledge.listGroupSubtitle: Group knowledge base · available to selected group members
journeySteps: Create or choose a knowledge base.
Upload files or add notes in the same place.
Ask questions and inspect citations in Ask.
knowledge.groupSystemDisabledHint: System project spaces are not tied to a group.
knowledge.listSystemSubtitle: System knowledge base · public project knowledge for authenticated Ask users

documents.title: Knowledge bases
documents.description: Add files or notes so Ask can answer with citations.
documents.contentHint: Text is prepared so Ask can cite the relevant passages.
documents.prepareRecoveryHint: Upload normally prepares this source for Ask. Run this only if preparation failed during upload or you need to refresh an existing text source.
documents.noExtractionRunsDescription: Details appear here while a source is being prepared.
documents.pdfUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), PowerPoint deck (.pptx), or Word document (.docx) into the selected private knowledge base. Legacy Office binaries are not supported.
documents.deleteDescription: Remove the selected source. This cannot be undone.
documents.createSourceSpaceFailedAnnouncement: Could not create the knowledge base.
documents.fileUploadHint: Upload a PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), PowerPoint deck (.pptx), or Word document (.docx) into the selected knowledge base so Ask can answer from it.
documents.multiFileUploadHint: Select one or more PDF, Markdown (.md/.markdown), plain text (.txt), Excel workbook (.xlsx), PowerPoint deck (.pptx), or Word document (.docx) files. Each file is limited to {maxSize}.
documents.dropTitle: Drag files here or choose files below
documents.dropDescription: Dropped files are checked locally, added to the queue, then uploaded and prepared as one workflow.
documents.unsupportedFileError: Unsupported file type. Choose PDF, Markdown, plain text, .xlsx, .pptx, or .docx.
documents.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Maximum size is {maxSize}.
documents.filesAddedAnnouncement: {count} files added to the upload queue.
documents.uploadRemovedAnnouncement: File removed from the upload queue.
documents.guestUploadLimitHint: Guest demo uploads are limited automatically; each accepted file counts toward the 3-source upload cap.
documents.knowledgeBaseTitle: Choose or create a knowledge base
documents.knowledgeBaseHint: Pick where these sources live. Start with a personal knowledge base; group sharing is available when you need it.
documents.stagingKnowledgeBaseHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then create a group approval request. The source becomes available only after a group owner/admin approves the group copy.
documents.teamUploadAutoApproveHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then auto-approve it because your role can manage this group. The approved group copy becomes the retrievable source.
documents.teamUploadApprovalHint: We stage the source privately outside Ask retrieval, then create a group approval request. The source becomes available only after a group owner/admin approves the group copy.
documents.noTeamDescription: Create or join a group before adding sources to group knowledge bases.
documents.noTeamKnowledgeBaseDescription: Create a group knowledge base below, or ask a group owner/admin to create one.
documents.teamUploadRequestedAnnouncement: {file} was sent for group source approval.
documents.teamTextApprovedAnnouncement: Text source was added to group sources.
documents.teamTextRequestedAnnouncement: Text source was sent for group source approval.
documents.knowledgeBaseRequired: Create or select a personal knowledge base before adding or preparing sources.
documents.noKnowledgeBaseDescription: Create a personal knowledge base here before adding sources. Group spaces receive sources through approved sharing.
documents.knowledgeBaseLockedHint: Finish or remove queued uploads before switching knowledge bases so each file stays attached to the intended library.
documents.askSourcesHint: Ready sources can be used in Ask with citations. System project knowledge may also be added automatically when available.
documents.createFirstSourceSpaceDescription: A knowledge base gives your files and notes one home before you ask from them.
documents.createSourceSpaceDescription: Use another space when you want to separate personal, project, or group sources.
documents.sourceSpacesDescription: {count} spaces for personal, group, or system project sources
documents.sourceSpacesSheetDescription: Choose the knowledge base to manage.
documents.sourceTableDescription: Select a row to review preparation details or delete a source.
documents.sourceActionsDescription: Preview, share, prepare, or delete this source without changing the selected knowledge space.
documents.sourcePreviewDescription: Preview content is loaded only when this dialog opens so source lists stay fast.
documents.sourcePreviewEmptyDescription: The service did not return Markdown or text for this source yet.
documents.shareSourceDescription: Create a group review request from this selected source. Pick a group and one of that group's knowledge bases; no document IDs are required.
documents.shareSourceFailed: Could not create the source share request.
documents.shareSourceSpaceDescription: Create a group review request for this whole personal knowledge base. The group owner/admin reviews it from Groups.
documents.shareSourceSpaceHint: Whole-space sharing is available for your personal knowledge bases only.
documents.shareSourceSpaceFailed: Could not create the source-space share request.
documents.shareNoGroupsDescription: Join or create a group before requesting a share.
documents.shareNoTargetSourceSpacesDescription: This group does not have a knowledge base yet. Ask a group owner/admin to create one before sharing a single source.
documents.renameSourceSpaceDescription: Update the display name for this knowledge base. Existing sources and citations stay attached.
documents.renameSourceSpaceFailed: Could not rename the knowledge base.
documents.deleteSourceSpaceDescription: Delete "{name}" and its contained sources. This cannot be undone.
documents.deleteSourceSpaceFailed: Could not delete the knowledge base.
documents.createSourceSpaceDialogDescription: Create a personal or group knowledge base, then add files or notes from the same page.
documents.noSystemKnowledgeBaseDescription: Create a system project knowledge base to manage public project knowledge for authenticated Ask users.
documents.systemSourcePublicWarning: System project sources can be retrieved automatically for authenticated Ask users, including guests. Do not upload secrets, credentials, or private records here.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups are invite-accepted spaces for shared sources. Invite people by email and review share requests sent from Sources.
groups.noSelectedDescription: Create or select a group first.
groups.patchMemberLabel: Active member user ID for role update
groups.membershipManagerOnlyHint: Only group owners and admins can invite people or change active member roles.
groups.publishBoundaryDescription: Groups share approved source copies. Start new share requests from Sources; this page is for membership and review.
groups.publishSourceDocumentHint: Use this to copy one document into a selected group knowledge base.
groups.publishTargetKnowledgeBaseHint: Choose the group knowledge base that should receive approved document-copy requests.
groups.publishReviewHint: Owner/admin-only approval or rejection; no auto-publish.
groups.publishReviewNoPreview: No preview available for this request.
groups.publishReviewExtractedContentHint: Review uses extracted text/Markdown from the upload, not the original file layout.
groups.publishReviewNoDocuments: No documents are available in this source request.
groups.publishOpenApiNote: Share requests are created from Sources, then reviewed here. Pending or rejected requests do not change group sources.
groups.publishSourceKnowledgeBaseHint: Share a whole personal knowledge base when the group should receive every source in it.
groups.memberIdNote: New access starts with email invitation acceptance. Display names help recognition, but active member role updates still use user ID for exactness and never create members.
groups.inviteEmailHint: The response does not reveal whether this email already has an account.
groups.noInvitationsDescription: Invite a teammate by email. Membership starts only after they accept while signed in.
groups.noMembersDescription: Owners and admins can review accepted members here after invitations are accepted.
groups.invitationActionHint: Use the invitation ID from the list. These actions never reveal account existence.
groups.patchMemberHint: Only use this for already-accepted members. It cannot create membership.
groups.emptyDescription: Create a group to invite members and share knowledge bases after approval.
groups.createGroupDialogDescription: Create an invite-accepted shared space. You can add sources and invite members after the group exists.
groups.membersSummary: Accepted members who can use this group according to their role.
groups.invitationsSummary: Pending invitations start by email and become membership only after acceptance.
groups.sourceSpacesDescription: Approved shared libraries connected to this group.
groups.noSourceSpacesDescription: Create a group knowledge base from Sources when this group needs shared knowledge.
groups.publishRequestsSummary: Personal sources waiting to be copied into group knowledge bases.
groups.noPublishRequestsDescription: Requests appear here after someone shares a knowledge base or document from Sources.
groups.membersDrawerDescription: Full invite-accepted member roster for {groupName}. User IDs stay inside advanced details.
groups.invitationsDrawerDescription: Email invitation history for {groupName}, managed by status without revealing account existence.
groups.sourceSpacesDrawerDescription: All group knowledge bases connected to {groupName}.
groups.publishRequestsDrawerDescription: Full share-request history for {groupName}. Only pending requests can be approved, rejected, or cancelled by the requester.
groups.hiddenRowsHint: +{count} more. Open the management view for the full list.
groups.publishRequestSearchPlaceholder: Search source, target, filename, request ID, or date
groups.invitationSearchPlaceholder: Search email, invitation ID, role, or date
groups.noFilteredResultsDescription: Adjust the search or filter and try again.

byStatus.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

byCode.guest_prompt_limit_reached: You have used every guest question. Create an account to continue.
byCode.guest_document_limit_reached: Guest sessions are limited to three documents.
byCode.upload_too_large: That file is too large. Reduce its size and upload it again.

appearance.title: Appearance settings
appearance.description: Choose how bright the interface is. This applies to this device only.
appearance.themeDescription: Follow your system setting, or pick light or dark yourself.

account.title: Account settings
account.description: Update display metadata and password-backed account credentials. Current password is required for every account change.
account.guestDisabledDescription: Guest sessions do not have password-backed account identity. Create a registered account to change nickname or password.
account.nicknameDescription: Your nickname is display metadata only. It is not used as a login identity and duplicates are allowed.
account.currentPasswordHint: Required to confirm this account change.
account.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out all sessions. Log in again with the new password after the update succeeds.
account.passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation must match.

experimental.title: Experimental settings
experimental.description: Control not-yet-stable product behavior that is safe to turn off later.
experimental.memoryDescription: When enabled, future assistant experiences may use your opt-in memory setting. This does not expose raw memory records, provenance IDs, custom values, or TTL controls.
experimental.privacyDescription: This toggle only changes your per-user opt-in state through the existing memory settings endpoint. You can disable it again at any time.
experimental.toggleHint: Memory starts disabled for users without an existing setting.
